description: Williamson et al. 1992 case 1 — solid-body advection of a cosine bell on the unit sphere, exercised via Path B (esd-5ou route). Routes ∂h/∂t = -∂h/∂lon through build_ode_problem → ESS.discretize(sys, CubedSphereGrid(8)) using the coord_jacobian chain rule. Tests that the Path-B infrastructure handles solid-body rotation on the cubed sphere end-to-end; this is the same physical scenario that ppm_reconstruction/fixtures/integration/williamson1992_cosine_bell.esm previously exercised via the imperative transport_2d_linrood! call chain. Full Lin-Rood dimensional-split PPM routing through fv3_lin_rood_advection.json requires ESS dimensional_split dispatch (dsc-esx follow-up); until that lands, this fixture covers the Path-B functional path and the ppm_reconstruction Williamson case is retired to stub.

tolerance.comment: Same tolerance as covariant_laplacian_cubed_sphere solid_body_rotation_path_b (Nc=8 unit sphere, centered-FD chain-rule scheme, non-dissipative — 50% of h0 allows for phase dispersion over one revolution). The Lin-Rood PPM accuracy ceiling will be tightened once ESS dimensional_split dispatch lands and the full PPM scheme is exercised end-to-end.
